analysis.summary: Unique ultra-tall vertical canvas (720x5120) depicting a complete ocean depth journey through four distinct zones: sunlit surface, coral reef, kelp forest, and bioluminescent abyss. Each zone is animated with characteristic life and movement, creating a continuous visual narrative of ocean depth exploration.

frames.text: Extremely tall vertical canvas (720x5120) showing four distinct ocean zones stacked: sunlit surface with light rays at top, vibrant coral reef with fish second, kelp forest third, and dark abyss with bioluminescent jellyfish at bottom. A complete ocean depth journey in one frame.

Mid-animation of the four-zone ocean composition. Bubbles rise through the sunlit surface zone, colorful fish swim among pink corals in the reef zone, golden kelp sways in the mid-depths, and glowing jellyfish pulse in the dark abyss below.

Full vertical ocean journey showing all four ecosystems: bright surface waters with sun penetration, lush coral reef teeming with life, cathedral-like kelp forest, and mysterious abyss with pink bioluminescent jellyfish. Rich color progression from warm to cool.
